lines.t: You held me before I knew your name
Before I could talk, before I could explain
You watched me grow from your arms to my own feet
Still somehow making every place feel like home to me
You were there for every ordinary day
For scraped up knees and tears I couldn't say
For every smile, every dream I brought to your door
You made me feel like I was worth so much more
I don't think I'll ever find the words
Big enough for everything you were
You don't even know how much you mean to me
You were there before I knew who I would be
From the little kid I was to this teenager now
You loved me through it all, you still show me how
Through the hard days and the good ones too
A piece of my heart will always look like you
And the greatest thing you ever gave to me
Was showing me how who's you were and his love for me
You never gave up when I was hard to reach
You loved me louder than the words you'd speak
You saw the good in me before I could
And you kept believing
There are a thousand things I wish I knew How to say the way they deserve to be said to you
But if this song is all I have tonight I hope you hear your love in every line
Cause every part of who I am Was shaped by the love inside your hands
You don't even know how much you mean to me
You were there before I knew who I would be
From the little kid I was to this teenager now
You love me through it all, you still show me how
Through the hard days and the good ones too
A piece of my heart will always look like you
And the greatest thing you ever gave to me
You're showing me how sure and it's loving me
One day I'll look back and I'll understand
How much you carried just to hold my hand
All the great things you gave for me
You're showing me how sure and it's loving me
One day I'll look back and I'll understand
How much you carried just to hold my hand
All the quiet things you did for me
And all the ways you made a plan
